page.overview:
Who is Ormuna Laaks?

Ormuna Laaks was approached by the Prisoner at her stall in Harko Village. She told them no to request any repair, construction and renovation work, as she was booked solid for the next eight months. She elaborated that the best she could do was give them supplies from what little she could get her hands on.
